claim: The current H1 reference StateLedger idempotency replay decision is not demonstrated to bind the full semantic request identity; visible code accepts same idempotency_key + same event_id as replay without comparing changed mutations/event_type/provenance.

counterexample.vulnerable_outcome: IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY of A instead of conflict
counterexample.required_outcome: reject changed semantic request as idempotency conflict while preserving A

does_not_refute: existing deterministic state-root tests within their tested scope
stale-epoch rejection within its tested scope
explicit epistemic-state preservation within its tested scope
snapshot/restore and tamper tests within their tested scope
the separate pre-lock concurrency-race negative result
repair_constraint: A replay must prove semantic request equivalence, not merely identifier reuse. At minimum bind event_id, event_type, normalized mutations and provenance (or an equivalent canonical semantic fingerprint). Retry-local execution metadata must not silently redefine semantic identity.
falsifier: Execute the actual module with same idempotency key/event_id but changed normalized semantic request; PASS only if the changed retry is deterministically rejected, committed state/epoch remain unchanged and ordinary identical retries still replay successfully.
